name: Caption bar
description: Manual captions: up to two lines of large white text on a dark band, centred near the bottom, readable on any background.

params.name: text
params.help: The caption. At most two lines show (about 90 characters); replace it with update_layer as the talk moves on

params.name: speaker
params.help: Who is speaking, shown as a small tag above (empty: none)

example.text: Welcome everyone, and thanks for joining today's session on the new release.
example.speaker: Alex

update.text: First, let's look at what changed since the last version.
update.speaker: Sam
